q: What does the BRSR life cycle assessment question ask for?
title: BRSR life cycle assessment question
short: It is a Principle 2 leadership indicator, so voluntary. It asks whether you have done a life cycle perspective or assessment for any product or service, and for each: NIC code, product name, share of turnover, the boundary, whether an independent agency did it, and whether results are public.
audience: Product, sustainability and R&D teams at listed companies

ul: NIC code and name of the product or service.
Percentage of total turnover it contributes.
Boundary for which the life cycle perspective or assessment was done.
Whether it was conducted by an independent external agency.
Whether results are communicated in the public domain, with a web link.

p: Leadership indicator 2 asks for any significant social or environmental concerns found through the assessment, or by other means, and the action taken. So an LCA that finds a hotspot should come with a plan.

sections.h: Start with the products that matter
p: Pick the products with the largest share of turnover or the most customer requests. A cradle-to-gate boundary is common for manufacturers and is honest to state. Supplier data on materials and energy is usually the largest gap.

senseible: Senseible turns a supplier's electricity bills and fuel invoices into Scope 1 and 2 figures for the financial year, with each bill linked to its line, so a customer's questionnaire can be answered from records. Figures are self-declared.

sources.label: SEBI LODR Master Circular, 11 July 2023, Annexure 16 (BRSR format)
